On Saturday afternoon, August 1, 2026, a gunman armed with an AR-style rifle opened fire at the newly opened In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho (Blue Lakes Boulevard). The attack began near the drive-thru and continued into the parking lot of a busy commercial area.

**Casualties:** Three people were killed, including one In-N-Out employee, and seven others were injured (some critically).

**Shooter’s death:** The suspect was found dead near the restaurant. According to In-N-Out President Lynsi Snyder and statements from law enforcement (including Jerome Police Chief Duane Rubink), the gunman died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

Witnesses reported that an armed bystander with a pistol exchanged fire with the shooter during the incident, which may have interrupted the attack. However, authorities have not attributed the shooter’s death to the bystander.

Police confirmed the threat to the community is over. The shooter’s identity and motive remain under investigation, with assistance from the FBI. Victim identities have not yet been publicly released.
